description: Reviewed depositary ratios of the depositary-receipt listings (ADR/ADS) in the database, used by valuation_metrics to turn a filed share count, which counts the underlying ordinary shares, into depositary-share equivalents: depositary shares = underlying shares / ordinary_shares_per_depositary_share. Only ratios read from the issuer's or the depositary's own SEC filing are listed, never one inferred from prices. 'valid_from' is the start of the first fiscal period the cited filing covers: a share count dated before it gets no ratio and the market cap stays empty. A listing that is not in this file keeps no share count.

sources.statement: each ADS represents five (5) common shares
